title: Remove slider controls and convert ServiceCarousel to static stacked cards

requirements.text: In the ServiceCarousel component, remove the circular up/down arrow navigation button, the pagination dots indicator, and the '1 / 8' counter text entirely from the rendered output.

quotes: Remove These Elements Completely: 1️⃣ The circular up/down arrow button (centered above image) 2️⃣ The dots indicator (pagination dots) 3️⃣ The '1 / 8' counter text

acceptanceCriteria: No circular arrow button is visible on the page
No '1 / 8' or any slide counter text is visible

requirements.text: Remove all carousel/slider logic from ServiceCarousel: eliminate touch/swipe event handlers, scroll-snap, hidden overflow, and any state tracking for the active slide index. Convert the component to a simple vertically stacked list of service category cards with normal block flow.

quotes: Disable slider functionality completely. Convert services into normal vertical stacked cards. Allow full smooth page scrolling. No swipe. No snap. No hidden overflow.

acceptanceCriteria: All service category cards are rendered in a single vertically stacked layout with no carousel wrapper
Page scrolls smoothly through the cards without snapping or jumping
No touch/swipe gesture handling interferes with normal page scroll
No overflow:hidden or scroll-snap CSS is applied to the cards container

requirements.text: Preserve the visual appearance of each service category card exactly: keep the card images, titles, descriptions, 'View Services' links, card design, colors, fonts, and spacing between cards unchanged.

quotes: Keep: • Service cards • Images • Titles • Descriptions • View Services link • Same spacing between cards
DO NOT change layout, DO NOT change card design, DO NOT change spacing, DO NOT change colors, DO NOT change fonts

acceptanceCriteria: Each card displays its image, title, description, and 'View Services' link identical to the previous design
Card spacing, colors, and fonts are visually unchanged from the version before slider removal

constraints: Do not change any card design, layout, colors, fonts, or spacing
Do not modify any backend files
Do not alter any other components outside of ServiceCarousel
nonGoals: Redesigning the service section in any way
Adding any new navigation or interaction patterns
Changing any other page or component
